import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define grid layout
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Top products by revenue (bar chart)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values, color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(product_revenue))/len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_title('Top Products by Revenue', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.set_xticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_xticklabels(product_revenue.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    ax1.text(i, v, f'${v:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 2. Sales by age group (stacked bar chart)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_takeaway = pd.crosstab(df['customer_age_group'], df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'}))
age_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax2, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax2.set_title('Sales by Age Group & Takeaway Status', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax2.legend(title='Service Type')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Payment method distribution (pie chart)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=plt.cm.Pastel1(range(len(payment_counts))))
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)

# 4. Price distribution by product (box plot)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='product', y='price', ax=ax4, palette='Set2')
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Product', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Product')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price ($)')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Sales by hour of day (line chart)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax5.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, color='#6A0572')
ax5.fill_between(hourly_sales.index, 0, hourly_sales.values, alpha=0.2, color='#6A0572')
ax5.set_title('Hourly Sales Pattern', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax5.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Size preference by product (heatmap)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
size_product = pd.crosstab(df['product'], df['size'], normalize='index') * 100
sns.heatmap(size_product, annot=True, fmt='.1f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'label': 'Percentage (%)'})
ax6.set_title('Size Preference by Product (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Size')
ax6.set_ylabel('Product')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 7. Revenue by age group and product (grouped bar chart)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
age_product_revenue = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'product'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_product_revenue.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, width=0.8)
ax7.set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Product', fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax7.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax7.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
